# Puravigal

> Puravigal is building practical SaaS software for micro and small businesses. Puravigal POS is the first product being released.

## Current product
- Puravigal POS: billing, products, inventory, purchases, customers, suppliers, reports and returns for small businesses.
- Business verticals: retail shops, restaurants, cafés, mobile shops, supermarkets and grocery/provision stores.

## Platform vision
Puravigal is being developed as a broader business software platform. Additional products and connected capabilities may be introduced over time as they are developed and released. Future ideas should not be treated as currently available products.
